prompt:
Fix snippets/warranty-status-3.liquid. The current file has a Liquid syntax error, crashes when there is no warranty, and is missing a status. Input (top-level variable, always supplied): - warranty: object or null. When it is an object it always has both keys: - warranty.status: string or null. - warranty.expires_on: string or null (a display date such as "2026-03-01"). Status mapping (exact, case-sensitive match on warranty.status): - "active" -> label "Under warranty" - "expiring" -> label "Warranty ending soon" - "expired" -> label "Warranty expired" Behavior: - If warranty is null, output nothing. Do not read its keys in that case. - If warranty.status is null or any value other than the three above (including different capitalization such as "Active"), output nothing. - Otherwise output exactly the following, with no leading or trailing whitespace or newlines and no whitespace between elements:
LABELTIME
- STATUS is the status value (active, expiring or expired). - LABEL is the mapped label. - TIME is DATE where DATE is warranty.expires_on with leading and trailing whitespace removed and then HTML-escaped with the escape filter. If expires_on is null, empty, or only whitespace, TIME is omitted entirely (no empty time element). Example: status "expiring", expires_on null ->
Warranty ending soon
Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/warranty-status-3.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
